args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following its deploy. Per the rollback runbook, the service was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback is complete and verified: all regions now run v2.3.0, health checks pass, and error rate is down to 0.2%. v2.3.1 (and its rc predecessor, which was also unhealthy in staging) should not be redeployed until root cause is identified.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 health check failures — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Its predecessor, v2.3.0, was the most recent release healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to v2.3.0 and verified the result: the service is now healthy with an error rate of 0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback action, and the verified recovery; the on-call engineer was paged.

Recommendation: hold off on redeploying v2.3.1 until root cause is found — note it was also unhealthy in staging as `v2.3.1-rc`.
